image_description: A close-up macro photograph of a butterfly resting on a textured grey rock. The butterfly has its wings held vertically closed, displaying the ventral surface which is primarily brownish-grey with a distinct orange patch on the forewing and faint white markings. The body appears fuzzy/hairy and brown. One antenna is visible, appearing segmented with a slight thickening at the tip. The background is blurred green vegetation.

The connection between the antenna and the head is slightly indistinct, with soft blending rather than a clear joint insertion point.
The shadow cast by the butterfly is inconsistent with the lighting direction implied by the highlights on the rock, suggesting slight floating or poor grounding.
